svg.aria-label: What the recorded run showed, on the Floci emulator: 18 of 18 invariants hold after the demo and again after both replays; 6 of 6 deliberate corruptions caught; 3,072 archived payloads replayed with nothing changed; 3,502 deliveries sent, 3,349 accepted and 153 rejected, 0 responses differing from the plan.
